objective: Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands. Show Myranda the Hag Tirion's Gift.

description: <name>, you have done all that I have asked thus far. Only one step remains in your quest of redemption.
You must deliver the items you have collected to Taelan. Unfortunately, Taelan and his Scarlet Crusaders will attack you on sight.
There is only one way in which to deliver my message and that is through a guise of deception.
To the south you will find Uther's tomb. An old and trusted confidant of mine, Myranda, now resides there - seek her out. Show her the items and she will assist you.
progress: I knew this day would come.
completion: I was Tirion's most trusted advisor when he held rank as Lord of Mardenholde. I openly dissented the verdict passed by the Order of the Silver Hand and was banished for my insolence.
He has been through much heart ache and disappointment in his life, <race>. Are you prepared to right the wrongs set upon the Fordrings?
